stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of molecular energies in one mole of a gas at two temperatures, $T_1$ and $T_2$.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution graph: proportion of molecules with energy E against molecular energy E, for two temperatures T1 and T2, with the area between E1 and E2 shaded.

items: The shaded area represents the proportion of molecules with energies between $E_1$ and $E_2$ at temperature $T_2$.
No particles have zero energy at either temperature.
